specsHeading: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Document Upload Limits.

sections.heading: Why NSP Scholarship documents get rejected.
body: The National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) enforces a strict 200 KB size ceiling for every uploaded file during the application window (typically September to November each year). Scanning multi-page marksheets or high-color revenue certificates at default scanner settings frequently creates file sizes of 1.5 MB to 3 MB.

Attempting to upload a PDF larger than 200 KB will trigger portal validation errors or silently drop the file attachment, leading to pending verification states or outright application rejection by institute verification officers.

sections.heading: How to compress NSP documents without losing legibility.
body: Because NSP verified officers manually check your seal, signature, registration number, and parent income figures, maintaining text crispness is essential.

Zcompressor uses browser-native vector re-encoding and image stream downsampling. It scales down heavy background textures while preserving official government stamps, seal text, and Roll Numbers clearly within the 200 KB target.

sections.heading: Recommended scanner settings for NSP applicant documents.
body: To avoid needing aggressive compression, scan your physical documents in Grayscale or 8-bit Color mode at 150 DPI to 200 DPI resolution. Avoid scanning in 600 DPI 24-bit full color, which unnecessarily balloons 1-page marksheets over 4 MB.
If you scanned documents on a mobile phone app, drag them into Zcompressor to target 200 KB before uploading to scholarships.gov.in.

faq.q: What is the exact document size limit for NSP Scholarship portal?
faq.a: All supporting documents on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)—including Aadhaar, Income Certificate, Marksheet, and Bank Passbook—must be in PDF or JPG format and strictly under 200 KB per file.

faq.q: Is NSP document compression safe on Zcompressor?
faq.a: Yes. Zcompressor executes all PDF optimizations 100% inside your browser using WebAssembly. Your income statements, bank account numbers, and Aadhaar files are never uploaded to any cloud server.

faq.q: What if my marksheets are multi-page PDFs?
faq.a: Zcompressor compresses multi-page PDFs cleanly while keeping the file under 200 KB. If needed, you can combine multiple semester marksheets and compress the final bundle into a single PDF under 200 KB.
